row.title: PROGRESS-1: progress is a public reading on the front end
row.body: Rowan, 2026-11-20: six months with no input, reading only the front end. The site Worker serves the merged changes of the last day, week and month from the tick Worker's cache at request time, with how many the system started itself, at /api/v1/progress and on /live; a week with none answers 503. A code agent session does not count toward the one-year target. Open follow-up: Q-YEAR-progress-loop.
